verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents only a REST Cloud API and no first-party MCP server. The only MCP servers in the evidence are unofficial, community-built third-party tools, which do not count as the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
